findings.passage: "My first Session, I was proud to co-sponsor and help pass the Voter ID bill," said Senator Charles Perry. "Election integrity is important, we cannot have individuals cast multiple ballots or allow non-citizens to remain on our voter rolls."
findings.note: Senate press release announcing his bills SB 795 and SB 796. The release text is dated February 26, 2014 while the file name reads 20150226, so the year is not settled and no date is given.

findings.passage: We never intentionally do anything to disenfranchise voters. On the contrary, the intent of that voter bill was to ensure the integrity at the [ballot] box, which gives those people that go to vote the confidence that their vote counts.
findings.note: Radio interview quoted by KFYO after a federal appeals court ruling against the Texas voter ID law. The outlet also reports he said lawmakers would find the objections, fix them, and reprocess the bill.

findings.passage: Co-Authored and helped pass legislation to prevent illegal immigrants from fraudulently voting in our elections.
findings.note: Campaign site issues page, listed under his immigration record. The page is undated.

findings.passage: Co-authored the bill to prevent fraudulent voting by requiring a photo ID to vote
findings.note: Ballotpedia reports this as an excerpt from the campaign themes on his 2012 campaign website; the original site page was not reached, so the wording is as Ballotpedia prints it.
